gloss: to grow thick, to be overgrown

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {茂|しげ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to grow thick, to be overgrown
definitions.explanation: For plants, grass, or trees to grow densely.

examples.english: The grass grows thick when summer comes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{茂|しげ}って⟦{日陰|ひかげ}→日陰：00100_hikage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The trees grew thick and created shade.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{茂|しげ}っている。
examples.english: Weeds are growing thick in the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両側|りょうがわ}→両側：28877_ryougawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{茂|しげ}っていて⟦{暗|くら}かった→暗い：00647_kurai⟧。
examples.english: Trees grew thick on both sides of the mountain path and it was dark.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐに→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{茂|しげ}って⟦しまう→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: If you don't maintain it, the garden quickly becomes overgrown with grass.

notes:
{茂|しげ}る means for vegetation to grow thickly or luxuriantly.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)
- No common transitive pair
- Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{茂|しげ}る

ASPECT (ている):
- {茂|しげ}っている: Is overgrown (resulting state)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{茂|しげ}る (grass grows thick)
- ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{茂|しげ}る (trees grow thick)
- ⟦うっそうと→うっそうと：noentry⟧{茂|しげ}る (to grow luxuriantly)
- ⟦{生|お}い{茂|しげ}る→生い茂る：22515_oishigeru⟧ (to grow thickly, to be overgrown)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧ (to grow, sprout)
- ⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧ (to grow, extend)
